title: Before you upgrade
loading: Checking disk space, backup and downtime
loadErrorNext: Reload the page or try again in a minute. Nothing was changed.

checks.label: Checks
checks.diskUnknown: Free disk space could not be measured
checks.backupSkipped: Backup skipped, there will be no restore point

downtime.label: Downtime
downtime.estimate: About {{seconds}} s offline while the server restarts

restore.label: If something goes wrong, restore with
restore.after: Keep this command. It restores the database to how it was before the upgrade.

blocked.disk: Not enough free disk. Free up {{short}} or move the data directory, then reload.
blocked.planUnknown: The upgrade plan failed. Reload the page, or run the upgrade from the command line.
blocked.notes: Release notes for this version are not available yet. Try again shortly.

skip.label: Skip the pre-upgrade backup
skip.warning: No restore point will be created. If the upgrade fails you cannot return to the current data.
skip.hint: The backup failed. Fix the cause and try again, or skip it at your own risk.

backupFailed.title: The pre-upgrade backup failed, so nothing was changed
backupFailed.next: Free up disk space or check that the backup directory is writable, then press Upgrade again. You can also skip the backup under Advanced.
